name: Anti-tank mine
description: A pressure-fused plate charge buried in a vehicle's path. It needs the weight of a hull to set it off, so a man walks over it; what it usually does is break a track and leave the tank sitting in the field it was laid to hold her in, crew shaken but whole.

name: Anti-personnel mine
description: A small charge set off by a foot. A track crushes it harmlessly; a rifle platoon walking into a belt of them loses men with every step.
